scope: Host-owned exact current Channel audience fact composition with optional exact Groups fallback, wrapped downstream by authoritative Forum trust facts

policy.request: exact normalized tenant and user plus bounded requested channel slugs and group IDs
policy.channel_owner: ChannelReadPort exact slug lookup with inactive channels hidden
policy.channel_truth: the current caller channel is requested and resolves active in the same tenant
policy.no_discovery: unrequested channels are never listed or probed
policy.positive_union: an exact active current channel decides before optional Groups; FORUM-26B resolves authoritative trust only after a confirmed membership miss
policy.groups: the historical FORUM-20Q adapter remains exact and is called only after a channel miss
policy.trust: FORUM-26B wraps this membership adapter with exact-actor authoritative forum_user_trust_states facts
policy.storage_access: the host membership adapter uses owner ports and performs no direct Channel or Groups entity access

not_delivered: remaining Forum read search index SEO and deep-link audience migration
scheduled notification reconciliation redaction transports and delivery-time authorization
PostgreSQL concurrency and cross-consumer runtime evidence
